item_name: Rothco Mini US Flag Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mini American Flag Patch features a smaller design compared to our standard U.S. flag patches and a hook back so you can attach the patch to your tactical gear.
description: Rothco’s Mini American Flag Patch features a smaller design compared to our standard U.S. flag patches and a hook back so you can attach the patch to your tactical gear. Measuring 1.5” X 2” and built with a high-quality construction, the small U.S. flag patches are available in a variety of colors and orientations.
